ingestion.page_subtitle: Triple-journey data pipeline with automatic @handle normalization, 3-tier deduplication, and outreach ledger collision protection.
ingestion.seed_title: SEA AI & Robotics Starter Pack (20 Profiles + 4 Historical Logs)
ingestion.seed_desc: Designed for instant, zero-friction evaluation. One click populates SQLite with 20 curated Southeast Asia profiles covering all core scouting scenarios and edge cases.
ingestion.seed_scenario_1: 8 Strong Matches (Score 4/4 — Founders & AI/Robotics Builders in VN, SG, TH, ID, MY)
ingestion.seed_scenario_2: 4 Moderate / Emerging Matches (Score 3/4 — Researchers & DevTools Engineers)
ingestion.seed_scenario_3: 3 Non-Fit Profiles (Score 1–2/4 — Crypto Shills, Generic Resellers, Outside SEA)
ingestion.seed_scenario_4: 5 Critical Edge Cases: Duplicate (@minh_quant), Sparse Bio (@mystic_coder99), Closed DM (@arjun_infer), Prompt Injection (@ignore_rules_ai), Historical Ledger Collisions
ingestion.segment_all: Auto-Detect / All SEA AI & Robotics Tracks
ingestion.csv_title: Custom CSV Batch Upload & Pre-flight Check
ingestion.csv_desc: Upload a researcher or event attendee list (.csv). The pipeline validates required columns (handle, name, bio, recent_tweets) and previews the first 5 rows before committing.
ingestion.csv_desc_live_x: Upload a list of target X handles (.csv). With Live X API v2 sync enabled, only the 'handle' column is required (max 25 rows/upload) — real name, bio, and 5 recent tweets are fetched directly from X.
ingestion.live_csv_note_body: To avoid synthetic handles and unnecessary pay-per-use X API spend, the downloadable CSV template in LIVE_PRODUCTION intentionally contains headers only (no mock candidates). Add real target @handles (or your own consented test X accounts), optionally set segment, and keep Live X API v2 sync enabled (max 25 rows/upload).
ingestion.paste_toggle_label: Or paste X handles / CSV content directly (no Excel edit needed)
ingestion.empty_rows_title: CSV headers are valid, but 0 candidate rows were found
ingestion.empty_rows_desc: Add at least 1 X @handle row in your CSV file (or use the Paste Handles box above) before importing. Empty 0-row batches stay blocked so no empty import runs by mistake.
ingestion.opt_dedup: Automatically deduplicate handles & block accounts already in Outreach Ledger
ingestion.opt_queue_ai: Automatically push newly imported profiles to background AI Evaluation Queue
ingestion.live_desc: Spot a promising founder on X? Enter their @handle or profile URL to inspect their bio, recent tweets, and DM availability before pushing to the AI scoring queue.
ingestion.live_lookup_note: LIVE_PRODUCTION mode: enter a real public X @handle or profile URL (synthetic mock handles are hidden). Outbound live DM sending stays restricted to ALLOWED_TEST_HANDLES.
